load_pickle_safely: load a pickle file from a path using the restricted unpickler that only allows safe modules
load_pickle_from_file_object: load a pickle file from a file-like object using the restricted unpickler with module allowlist
review_RestrictedUnpickler_find_class: review the _RestrictedUnpickler find_class method to understand how it validates modules against the allowlist
add_safe_module_prefix: add a new module prefix to _SAFE_MODULE_PREFIXES to allow pickling classes from that module
disable_pickle_warning: call safe_pickle_load with warn=False to suppress the deprecation warning about pickle security
